runs.question: What change to the NIST AI RMF does America's AI Action Plan recommend, and which characteristics of trustworthy AI does the AI RMF itself list?

answer.text:
The passages don't answer the first part. None of them mention America's AI Action Plan or any recommended change to the AI RMF. The closest material is that the Framework is a "living document" that NIST reviews regularly, with a formal review expected no later than 2028 (NIST will review the content and usefulness of the Framework regularly to determine if an update is appropriate; a review with formal input from the AI community is expected to take place no later than 2028.). That is NIST's own update schedule, not a recommendation from the Action Plan, so I can't tie it to the question.

On the second part, the AI RMF describes trustworthiness through a set of characteristics. Its overview says the Framework is organized so that its characteristics of trustworthy AI systems are analyzed after the risks are framed (Part 1 discusses how organizations can frame the risks related to AI and describes the intended audience. Next, AI risks and trustworthiness are analyzed, outlining the characteristics of trustworthy AI systems). The list itself carries over the page break onto page 8. It names systems that are valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy enhanced, and fair, with harmful biases managed (valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy enhanced, and fair with their harmful biases managed).

The passages are fragmentary at the page break, so I can't confirm from them whether this is the complete list.

support.reason: Passage states NIST will review content and usefulness regularly, with formal AI community input no later than 2028, and calls it a living document.
Passage says Part 1 frames risks and describes audience, then AI risks and trustworthiness are analyzed, outlining trustworthy AI characteristics.
Passage lists the same characteristics: valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy enhanced, fair with harmful biases managed.
